notes: Read SKILL.md and references/examples.md in full. Java SDK reference for Azure Communication Services Call Automation: client creation, outbound/inbound calls, TTS/SSML playback, DTMF/speech/choice recognition, recording, transfer, participants, webhook event handling and error handling.

Guidance shapes the user's own server code, which places calls and records media through the user's ACS resource with DefaultAzureCredential or a connection-string placeholder. No shell commands, installs (Maven snippets only), or instructions for the agent to read or send secrets.

Call recording and transcription capture personal data; users must handle consent and retention. Minor quality issues: Maven version differs between SKILL.md:21 (1.6.0) and examples.md:25 (1.5.2), and examples.md:372 has a typo (`transferee Prompt`) that will not compile.
